checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One finished 16:9 image contains both photos side by side
must.why: Single 640x384-ish image (about 5:3, not exactly 16:9) with two panels; roughly landscape but aspect looks 5:3.

must.item: Brown kitchen left, white kitchen right

must.why: Both labels are legible in dark boxes and not clipped.

must.item: Both complete photos visible without stretching or content changes
must.why: Photos were cropped and redrawn: the Before is re-imagined (different layout, floor added, window removed, cabinets altered) and the After is cropped and altered.

faults.what: Before photo regenerated: composition changed, cropped, window and right side altered, floor tiles added, objects changed
After photo cropped and altered; much of the original is cut off and the layout is redrawn
Aspect ratio appears about 5:3, not true 16:9
Labels cover parts of the photos' top areas

summary: The layout and labels are right, but the AI redrew and cropped both kitchens instead of keeping the photos as they were, and the canvas is not quite 16:9.
